description_en: Queries the information about a shared key
description_zh: 查询主机共享密钥的详情
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-host-share-key --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-share-key-id 10427 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetHostShareKey

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the shared key whose information you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462973.html operation to query the shared key ID
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的主机共享密钥的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/462973.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_share_key_id

HostShareKey.description_en: The returned information about the shared key

HostShareKeyId.description_en: The ID of the shared key

HostShareKeyName.description_en: The name of the shared key

LastModifyKeyAt.description_en: The time when the information about the shared key was last modified. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
LastModifyKeyAt.description_zh: 主机共享密钥上次修改的时间（秒，时间戳格式）

PrivateKeyFingerPrint.description_en: The fingerprint of the private key

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
